title: LEGS & BALANCE
subtitle: MONDAY EASE. LIGHT LEGS. STEADY BALANCE.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Monday is light legs and balance — a small break from the desk, nothing heroic. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Light legs, a bit of balance, and you showed up. Enjoy your day — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Lift one knee, lower with control. Alternate. Soft on the joints. Stay seated the whole way. Smaller lift is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts. Two sets of eight each side. Sit tall, lift one knee, lower with control. Soft and steady.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Stay seated. Easy breath.

exercises.name: CHAIR SIT TO STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair. Feet flat. Stand up with control, then sit down softly. Use the armrests if you like. Only a comfortable range — no deep drop. Empty hands or light weights optional.
exercises.speakStart: Chair sit to stand. Two sets of six. Near the front of the chair, stand up with control, sit down softly. Use the armrests if you like. Keep it comfortable.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Soften the knees. Breathe easy.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stands done. You're doing well.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside the chair. Light fingertips on the back for support. Lift one foot a little. Stay tall. Hold the chair more if you need — balance aid is the point.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance. Two holds of twenty seconds each side. Light fingertips on the chair, lift one foot a little, stay tall. Use as much support as you like.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Both feet down. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall on the chair. Hinge gently from the hips with a long spine. Reach toward your shins — stop well short of pain. Smaller range is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach. Two holds of twenty seconds. Sit tall, hinge softly from the hips, long spine. Only as far as feels kind.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Sit upright and breathe.
exercises.speakDone: Forward reach done. That's the session — lovely work.
